en: This is a black and white vintage postcard showing a street scene with soldiers marching, led by a mounted officer. There are buildings with European architectural style lining the street, and civilians, including a person on a bicycle, are visible in the foreground. The setting suggests a parade or military procession. The text at the bottom reads '8 Bataillon passerer Abigate.'
